name: kw-ad
description: Agentic development workflows with hook-enforced per-agent scope. First workflow: a TDD feature-delivery pipeline (/kw-ad:tdd) -- plan, red, green, refactor, document, ship, audit.

hook_runtime.title: Hook runtime
hook_runtime.description: Interpreter command for the scope-enforcement hook: "node" (Node.js 18+), "python3", or "python" (Python 3.8+). Must be on PATH. Use "python" where "python3" is missing or a stub (e.g. Windows). Checked at session start; run /kw-ad:doctor to verify.

repo_owner.title: Repository owner
repo_owner.description: The org/user that owns the repository this plugin is used in (e.g. "KillianW"). Substituted into agent/skill prose.

repo_name.title: Repository name
repo_name.description: The repository's name (e.g. "rkg"). Substituted into agent/skill prose.

default_branch.title: Default branch
default_branch.description: The branch new work branches from and ships back to.
